text:
faye: Heads-up: reproducible Retrofit/OkHttp quirk on Android 11-14 where callTimeout triggers during background network handoff and shows as canceled instead of timed out. Hit in our sampleapp while switching VPN.

igor: Repro steps?

faye: Start long poll to /v1/poll (30s), toggle VPN on device -> call dies instantly: `IOException: Canceled`. Logs: 
```
D/OkHttp: callStart POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/poll
W/Network: VPN state changed
E/OkHttp: java.io.IOException: Canceled
    at okhttp3.internal.connection.ExchangeFinder.findConnection(ExchangeFinder.kt:...)
    at okhttp3.internal.connection.RealCall.execute(RealCall.kt:...)
Caused by: java.net.SocketException: Socket closed
```

ben: That's similar to other network-switch cancellations, but interesting that callTimeout isn't honored. Our retry layer treats canceled as retriable and duplicates non-idempotent polls.

igor: Quick fix options: 1) set `retryOnConnectionFailure(false)` for mobile default; 2) treat `SocketException` with "Socket closed" as SYSTEM_CANCEL and avoid automatic retry; 3) add short backoff before retry when network change detected.

faye: Also see duplicate token refresh when refresh concurrent with retry. Adding singleflight for refresh should help.

ben: Can we add `EventListener` telemetry to tag cancel reason so we can triage? I'll file SDK-1011.

qa-bot: Created ticket SDK-1011: "Android: distinguish system-induced OkHttp cancels; prevent blind retries" (<https://issues.redwood/SDK-1011>)

igor: I'll prototype changing default mobile OkHttp builder to `retryOnConnectionFailure(false)` and exposing a `NetworkAwareRetryPolicy` in SDK. faye, can you run sample across VPN toggle and upload logs?

faye: Yep, will attach adb logs and minimal repro. Thanks!
